raw_response:
I farm only 3.5 mu, so I cannot do fancy things. I do what has worked on my land. Wheat and maize together keep the family steady. If one side is bad, the other can still bring something back. We have a well, so I will not leave the crop to the sky alone, but water costs money, so I will not irrigate too many times unless the field really looks dry. I usually put a bit more fertilizer on wheat than on maize, because wheat is already in the ground longer and if it turns yellow, I worry. I do not want to spend all my cash at once, so I split some fertilizer and wait to see how the crop looks. For maize after wheat, the turnaround is tight, so I will keep it simple, quick harvest, quick sowing, light tillage, then get the seed in fast. Most labor is from family, and if the off-farm people are away, I just do the main jobs first and skip anything extra.
